Steps[]

  2. Return to Honami for the final purge
  3. Complete the final purge

Gameplay Notes[]

Dialogue[]

Complete the final Purge
Hiyuki: (Gyokuro must be just ahead...)
Hiyuki: (This was Honami's last Rite of Purging.)
Hiyuki: (All is settled. Only one final thing remains.)
Hiyuki: (I have truly... kept you waiting for too long, Gyokuro.)
Gyokuro: Finally came to see me?
Hiyuki: Yes. I have come.
Gyokuro: Made up your mind?
Hiyuki: I have.
Gyokuro: Ready to kill me, then?
Hiyuki: ...Yes.
Gyokuro: Oh? Has my little Hiyuki grown so confident that she can best me without even drawing her blade?
Gyokuro: Now, now... Don't forget who taught the Miko of Eternal Flaming Sakura. Can't show a little respect to your elder?
Hiyuki: You call wha tyou did to me teaching, Gyokuro?
(Cutscene plays)
Gyokuro: Come then, Miko of Eternal Flaming Sakura.
Gyokuro: Calm yourself.
Gyokuro: A restless heart makes for unsteady hands.
Hiyuki: But... I do not wish to learn this.
Gyokuro: Then what do you wish to learn?
Onlooker 1: This girl will become a great archer.
Onlooker 2: No, look at her hands... they're a swordsman's hands.
Gyokuro: Not in this life.
Gyokuro: Her hands aren't ones to hold a blade. Isn't that right?
Gyokuro: Well now. You have refined your technique.
Gyokuro: Hiyuki...
Gyokuro: Do not let the Suzu bind your fate.
Gyokuro: Go seek a future of your own.
Gyokuro: Focus, Hiyuki.
Gyokuro: Survive this strike—
Gyokuro: And reach your tomorrow.
Gyokuro: Tsk, tsk. You have mastered many skills from others, but have yet to master the bladework of your own Flaming Sakura clan.
Hiyuki: The last Miko withheld too much. She refused to teach me a single technique.
Gyokuro: Do you resent her?
Hiyuki: I do.
Gyokuro: Even now?
Hiyuki: Every moment.
Hiyuki: I resent that she did not step down long ago. Instead, she burned every future she had and left nothing behind. Not even ashes.
Hiyuki: I resent that she did not pass her skills to me. That she sent me away each time she trained. Now... there is nothing of her left in me.
Gyokuro: Hiyuki...
Hiyuki: I resent that she always told me to "be myself," yet chose a death that was nothing like herself.
Gyokuro: And you resent that even after dying, she lingered as a spirit, waiting only for you to send her on.
Gyokuro: Ah, I was being cruel, wasn't I?
Gyokuro: It's just... I couldn't let my fear go. No one understood the scale of your gift, Hiyuki. Your potential to tame even a Threnodian.
Gyokuro: If you drew such a future, would everything not become much easier?
Hiyuki: Gyokuro, I...
Gyokuro: As long as it comes from your own heart and will, any future you choose is acceptable.
Gyokuro: But if our little Hiyuki truly became a Threnodian Resonator... Well. I'd have no choice but to follow "family law" and send us both on our way.
Hiyuki: I have already burned that future.
Hiyuki: I accepted the Suzu of my own will. I chose to become the Miko of Flaming Sakura.
Hiyuki: I know why you refused to teach me your swordsmanship. You never wanted there to be another Miko after you.
Hiyuki: I will fulfill that wish, Sister.
Hiyuki: After Hiyuki, there will be no more Mikos of Flaming Sakura.
Gyokuro: The Miko of Eternal Flaming Sakura... That is a heavy title to bear.
Hiyuki: It is.
Gyokuro: The future ahead is long. Very, very long.
Hiyuki: I know.
Gyokuro: Through the Suzu, we draw strength from countless possible futures.
Gyokuro: But each time you do, you see yourself draw closer to Miko's desired end. A future burned to cinders, leaving nothing behind.
Hiyuki: Yes. And before that destined end arrives, I will find a way to drive back the Threnodian.
Hiyuki: So that Gyokuro may simply be Gyokuro. So that Hiyuki may simply be Hiyuki. So that Ashinohara will no longer need a Miko of Flaming Sakura.
Gyokuro: You have grown up, our little Hiyuki.
Hiyuki: ...
Hiyuki: I met someone, Sister. Unlike me, who failed Ashinohara, (‍‍heText for male Rover‍/‍sheText for female Rover‍‍) always finds a way to save.
Gyokuro: That must be difficult for you to bear, little Hiyuki.
Hiyuki: Yes. At first... it was.
Hiyuki: Hearing tales of (‍‍hisText for male Rover‍/‍herText for female Rover‍‍) exploits, I felt a deep admiration. No, perhaps it was closer to jealousy.
Hiyuki: I thought, if only I possessed (‍‍hisText for male Rover‍/‍herText for female Rover‍‍) strength. Then my days would not be filled with regret. Ashinohara would be saved.
Hiyuki: And I... in the peace that followed, could have lived an ordinary life.
Hiyuki: But upon meeting (‍‍himText for male Rover‍/‍herText for female Rover‍‍), I cam eto understand. Even a great "savior" carries many pains and failures.
Hiyuki: And the path of savior is walked not alone, but alongside countless others.
Hiyuki: Gyokuro.
Gyokuro: Yes?
Hiyuki: I have always admired you as the Miko of Flaming Sakura. And I have always... held you in the highest honor.
Hiyuki: Even if one day I am burned to ashes...
Hiyuki: Because of you... because of (‍‍himText for male Rover‍/‍herText for female Rover‍‍)... because they all exist... I am never truly alone.
Gyokuro: I take great pride in you, too.
Gyokuro: Go on, Shiratori. Fly to where your heart desires.
Gyokuro: May the day come when you, too... step into spring as freely as anyone in this world.
(Hiyuki's phone rings)
Fractsidus Grand Architect: Greetings, Miko of Flaming Sakura.
Hiyuki: ...You.
Fractsidus Grand Architect: Oh, relax. I'm not here to recruit you. I just heard a piece of news and thought you might want to know.
Fractsidus Grand Architect: Not long ago, that island floating over the sea, your hometown--
Fractsidus Grand Architect: It vanished. All in a single day.
Fractsidus Grand Architect: Congratulations on your wish coming true, Lady Miko.
